title: DOE-UAP-D002, James Tuck Correspondence, 1970s
doc_notes: This document consists of personal correspondence to and from James Tuck regarding UAP sightings and scientific research, containing some redactions.

incidents.summary: Multiple sightings of green lights near Los Alamos, Jemez Mountains.
behavior: weaving in and out of mountain peaks
incidents.quote: several sightings of green lights were made at Los Alamos

incidents.summary: Five objects flying in formation over Los Alamos.
incidents.quote: one instance of five objects flying over Los Alamos in the afternoon
